coverage.target: Engine resolution defaults to the offline implementation whenever no credential is usable (reliability-design.md; Settings resolver, Engine interface)
The test harness blocks outbound use and raises on any attempt; the live transport is injectable (reliability-design.md; Live transport)
Redaction by construction in every representation, asserted over settings, logs and bodies (security-design.md; Settings resolver, Session credential holder)
One credential source order: session credential, then the gitignored local file (security-design.md; Settings resolver)
No pooling, caching or batching layer; two runtime packages plus the standard library (performance-design.md, tech-stack-decisions.md)
Test, coverage and lint tooling stay under the development extra (tech-stack-decisions.md)
The coverage report is produced over the whole application by the verification command and compared against the floor at every checkpoint (observability-design.md)
The suite result plus the coverage report are the visibility a change gets, since the scope runs no pipeline (observability-design.md)
A single loopback bind constant used by the server start path and asserted by the smoke check (security-design.md)
One process and one file; no hosted service, container or account (security-design.md, scalability-design.md)
One connection-state payload consumed by the health endpoint and the page, so they cannot disagree (observability-design.md; Connection state)
Startup records the resolved mode and warns, naming the config file, when live was requested with no usable key (observability-design.md)
Log lines are built from the redacted representations, so a credential has no formatting path into a log (observability-design.md)
